capabilities: Render Dataview queries as card grids via datacards code blocks
Create interactive kanban boards with inline editing
Apply card presets (grid, portrait, square, compact, dense, kanban) with per-block overrides
Display frontmatter images on cards from wiki links and embeds
Configure global defaults with per-block settings and mobile options
disambiguation: Not a data-management tool; it only changes how Dataview query results are displayed.
extras: Unmaintained because it depends on Dataview, which the author says has been abandoned. Not yet in the Community plugin store; install via BRAT or manually. Full documentation lives on an external site.
intentEvidence: Data Cards is built entirely on top of Dataview
problem: Dataview queries return plain lists and tables, so visual card layouts require manual HTML/CSS work.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses the Dataview API
Obsidian now offers Bases as a native core plugin, which covers most of what Data Cards does

summary: Renders Dataview query results as customizable card grids and interactive kanban boards inside notes.
